title: Sahih International of surah 112 says Allah is one
summary: Sahih International renders Quran 112:1 as 'Say, He is Allah, [who is] One.'
body: The Sahih International translation of Quran 112:1 says: Say, He is Allah, who is One. The surah is a short statement of divine uniqueness. The API also returns the Uthmani Arabic. The wording on the page includes: "Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One,". The evidence label is the truth-gate ceiling for this host. The host is not on the gate's primary-text or official list, so the label is weak. The quotation is still the page's wording.
